Cookie package before version 0.7.0 contains an out-of-bounds validation flaw when parsing domain attributes.

### Impact
Attackers can bypass domain cookie isolation under certain proxy configurations.

### Patched Versions
Upgrade to version **0.7.0** or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

### References
- https://github.com/jshttp/cookie/commit/d265330e
